from the adapter and the laptop
top rail = 5 V from the MB102 (for loads)

MOSFET (text facing you): G 42b, D 43b, S 44b · white wire 11f (D25) → 38e
220 Ω resistor 38d–42d · 10 kΩ 34c–38c · black wire 44d → top rail (−) · red top rail (+) → 48a
1N4007 diode 43e–48e, silver ring at 48e · pump: red → 48c, black → 43d
